A ^006400MAP^000000 shows you things that is much needed for travelling around the world; such as the lay of the land, major towns and fields and such. It's a very important tool!
Because of this, it's more important than everything else that you know about ^006400MAP^000000s.
The map can be accessed by clicking on the button that says ^006400MAP^000000 on the upper left side of your screen.
When you click on the ^006400MAP^000000 button, a full sized map of Midgard will take up your screen.
When you ^0000FFHover your mouse over specific areas^000000, you can find out more things such as ^006400NAME^000000 and Area Details.
If you look to the lower right side of your map, there is a ^006400Poring drawing^000000.
If you click on it or press the ^006400TAB^000000 shortcut key, you will be able to various information.
Firstly, you can find out the ^006400NAME^000000 and ^006400LEVEL^000000 of the monsters in each area. That will take a lot of the guess work out of where you want to go hunt.
Secondly, You can locate various ^006400DUNGEON^000000s and their
^006400Entrance Location^000000. Plus, it'll also tell you monsters that reside in that area
along with their ^006400LEVEL^000000. It's displayed in red so it's easy to find.
If you want to stop looking at the map, there are 2 ways to do this.
You can press the shortcut keys which are ^006400CTRL + %^000000 or ^006400ESC^000000
Or at the top right of the map, there is a ^006400X^000000 button. Click that and you will return to your normal game screen.
Currently, we cannot see places that are beyond Midgard but it has been said that there are a lot of unknown worlds that exist in the beyond.
